evidence_slice: Historic England official NHLE record 1239561 identifies Nos. 161 and 163 Magdalen Road, Exeter, as a pair of early-C19 detached villas, Grade II. Historic England's official Open Data Hub publishes Listed Building polygons and states the current polygon data update date as 6 October 2026. The distinct official layer-3 query requested ListEntry 1239561 with ListEntry, Name, Grade, dates, capture scale, hyperlink, area_ha, NGR, easting, northing and geometry. The web retrieval channel could not return the query payload, and a direct network request failed at DNS resolution, so no record-level rings or polygon coordinates were available.

field_evidence.type_use: Official NHLE record summary identifies a pair of early-C19 detached villas; details identify a pair of C19 villas.
field_evidence.heritage: Official NHLE record identifies Grade II, List Entry 1239561, Exeter.
field_evidence.footprint: Official Historic England Listed Building polygons layer is the requested record-level geometry source, but the exact layer-3 query returned no retrievable payload in the available channel; direct DNS resolution also failed. No geometry accepted.
